But GMGN tags 440 bundler wallets, puts the bot/degen rate at 76% and has bundlers at 37% of top traders. 320 fresh wallets and 16 snipers also appear. No paid boosts or DexScreener profile. There are 42 smart and 3 renowned wallets, but zero smart-money signals or call counts. The X handle unpegdotio is tied to 47 launched tokens, and there are at least 10 same-name tokens. That points to a hot project name being farmed by many deployers, not a single organic launch.

structured_output.thesis: UNPEG (Meteora DBC, migrated 40 seconds after launch) has very strong early demand: about $600k of volume in 15 minutes, 1,500+ unique buyers, and 100% of LP burned with authorities renounced. But it faces a crowded same-name field, including an earlier pump.fun UNPEG at about $27.7M mcap that looks like the likely canonical token. Heavy bundler and bot activity and the 47 tokens tied to the linked X handle both point to name-farming. Entry comes after a +450% move with sell pressure appearing. The upside depends entirely on whether the project endorses this contract. Estimated chance of a runner is somewhat above the base rate, around 20%.
